mapper.select: SELECT FROM payment_attempt WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND order_id=#{order}
SELECT FROM payment_attempt WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND payment_id=#{id}
SELECT FROM payment_attempt WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND payment_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_attempt SET status=#{status},version=version+1,channel_transaction_id=#{transaction},evidence_json=#{evidence} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND payment_id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status IN ('UNKNOWN','OPEN')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_sandbox_ledger(tenant_id,payment_id,order_id,amount,currency,status) VALUES(#{tenant},#{view.paymentId},#{view.orderId},#{view.amount},#{view.currency},'UNKNOWN') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE payment_id=payment_id
mapper.select: SELECT payment_id,tenant_id,order_id,CAST(amount AS CHAR) amount,currency,status,transaction_id FROM payment_sandbox_ledger WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND payment_id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_sandbox_ledger SET status=#{status},transaction_id=#{transaction} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND payment_id=#{id} AND status IN ('UNKNOWN','OPEN')
UPDATE payment_sandbox_ledger SET status='CLOSED' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND payment_id=#{id} AND status='OPEN'
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,payment_id,order_id,check_attempts FROM payment_attempt WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND status IN ('UNKNOWN','OPEN') AND check_attempts<5 AND next_check_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY next_check_at,payment_id LIMIT 5
SELECT DISTINCT tenant_id FROM payment_attempt WHERE tenant_id>#{after} AND status IN ('UNKNOWN','OPEN') AND check_attempts<5 AND next_check_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY tenant_id LIMIT 4
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_attempt SET check_attempts=check_attempts+1,next_check_at=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,#{delay},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND payment_id=#{id} AND check_attempts=#{attempts} AND check_attempts<5 AND status IN ('UNKNOWN','OPEN') AND next_check_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
